grid_contract.movement: Floor and ladders passable; wall blocks movement with pass_wall=1 and dig to CRYSTAL_FLOOR.
grid_contract.sight: Floor and ladders open; wall blocks sight.
grid_contract.danger: No inherent hazard; unrelated vault grids remain native.
grid_contract.interaction: Ladders keep native level and world destinations; DIG unchanged.
grid_contract.export: 128px parity pair; wall connected N/E/S/W 16-mask set.

prompt_fields.subject: Opaque flat dark slate crystal-cave ground with small embedded violet and cyan mineral flecks, subtle broad mineral seams, no raised obstacles or implied speed bonus.
prompt_fields.contrast: Readable at 48/64/96px; solid wall at least 18% value apart from floor; calm connected interior.
prompt_fields.composition: Overhead seamless square, all edges opaque. The bright flecks are sparse; this is a passable floor.
prompt_fields.palette: Cool desaturated indigo, slate, violet and muted turquoise with broad readable value.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Preserve native movement, sight, digging and destinations in art; no text, symbols, actor or hazard icon.
